title: Blue-hour horizon
prompt: Create an exceptionally polished 16:9 marketplace campaign thumbnail for Salat Times, a native Omarchy prayer-time plugin. Exact text: 'SALAT TIMES'; supporting text 'Prayer times for Omarchy'; small feature line 'Worldwide • Hijri • Qibla'. Art directed, strong focal point and legible title at small size, intentional composition. No emerald or green, no clock ring, no UI screenshots or imaginary app screens. No extra marketing claims, no watermark. This is one of three design options for user selection. Direction 3: A highly cinematic contemporary product-brand poster. A magnificent mosque dome and two minarets in silhouette occupy the lower third against a luminous cobalt-to-indigo blue-hour sky; a narrow coral-orange band of evening light at the horizon. Monumental SALAT TIMES title in warm-white geometric sans-serif occupies the upper half with exceptional optical spacing and confident weight. Tiny stars only if realistic, no moon, no celestial fantasy, no glow effects. Strong horizontal composition, beautiful quiet negative space, photographic atmosphere, precise editorial typography. Small subtitle and features between title and skyline. Distinctively blue, contemporary and eye-catching.
